text:
cheng: heads up — I'm bringing up a hybrid-quant candidate 'rwd-v2.4-hq-int8-hybrid' on staging. want a short checklist for canary gates + auto-fallback before we flip any production slices. signals we care about: MRR_rerank, nDCG/concordance, hallucination rate (sampled), latency_p95, cost_per_tok. planning staged roll: 1% -> 5% -> 20%. any redlines?

eva: +1. suggested thresholds (opinionated):
- hold windows: 30m @1%, 60m @5%, 3h @20%
- auto-fallback triggers (relative to current prod baseline):
  • MRR drop > 1.0% (relative) OR absolute drop > 0.8pp
  • nDCG decrease > 0.7%
  • hallucination rate increase > 1.5 percentage points (manual sample)
  • latency_p95 increase > 15%
- require minimum sample size per stage: 3k requests
these are conservative but keeps user-facing regressions rare. :lock:

ryan: stats caveat — use sequential / group-sequential testing (SPRT or bayesian) rather than just point deltas. minimum effective N = 3k, but for long-tail doc tasks you may need 10k to detect small MRR shifts. also check variance by slice (longform, code, shortanswer).

ana: quick rollout config example (we use this pattern in the deployment tool):
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-v2.4-hq-int8-hybrid",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "hold_minutes": 30},
    {"pct": 5, "hold_minutes": 60},
    {"pct": 20, "hold_minutes": 180}
  ],
  "metrics": ["mrr_rerank", "ndcg", "hallucination_pp", "latency_p95", "cost_per_tok"],
  "fallback_rules": [
    {"metric": "mrr_rerank", "type": "relative_drop", "threshold": 0.01},
    {"metric": "hallucination_pp", "type": "absolute_increase", "threshold": 1.5},
    {"metric": "latency_p95", "type": "relative_increase", "threshold": 0.15}
  ],
  "min_requests_per_stage": 3000
}
```

ops-bot: smokecheck @cheng — results from 1k shadow samples in staging:
- MRR_rerank: baseline 0.423 -> candidate 0.419 (delta -0.95%)
- nDCG: baseline 0.512 -> candidate 0.508 (delta -0.78%)
- hallucination (manual sample 200): baseline 2.1% -> candidate 3.0% (+0.9pp)
- latency_p95: baseline 120ms -> candidate 125ms (+4.2%)
- cost_per_tok: -18% (candidate cheaper)
note: sample sizes small for hallu check, tagging for manual review.

cheng: thanks. plan: run 2k shadow + 1% live (30m) -> evaluate. auto-rollback criteria I'll set to: MRR_rel_drop >= 1.0% OR hallucination_pp_increase >= 1.5 OR latency_p95_rel_increase >= 15% OR any slice with p<0.01 by sequential test. if any trigger hit, immediate rollback and escalate to eng-ml.

eva: +1 to that plan. also add quiet-burn (shadow 5k) during off-peak for 24h to catch low-frequency failures.

ryan: i'll wire up the SRT test metric and per-slice CI dashboards. baseline windows = last 7 days traffic.

cheng: executing now. will post live metrics in this thread after the 30m hold. tagging eva/ryan for triage if triggers fire. :rocket:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout 1% -> rwd-v2.4-hq-int8-hybrid @1717777020

cheng: (30m update) live 1% finished — aggregated metrics:
- MRR_rel_delta: -0.6% (pass)
- nDCG_rel_delta: -0.5% (pass)
- hallucination_pp: +1.2pp (watch, below auto-rollback threshold)
- latency_p95_rel: +6% (pass)
- requests: 4,100 (meets min)

ana: sounds safe to advance to 5% with 1h hold. keep the manual hallucination sample ongoing and tag examples to the eval board.

cheng: advancing to 5% now. will keep this thread live.

(ends)
